title: Wolves IMAX Documentary DVD 2002 - Sealed, Brand New
descriptionText: "WOLVES" is a documentary film published on DVD in 2002, originally presented in IMAX format in 1999. Directed by David Douglas and produced by Goulam Amarsy and Pietro L. Serapiglia, this DVD showcases the stunning visuals and storytelling of the IMAX experience. The film takes viewers on a captivating journey to explore the world of wolves, featuring beautiful footage and insights into these iconic animals. With the added bonus of being sealed, this DVD ensures a fresh viewing experience for nature enthusiasts and wildlife lovers alike.
